rationale: The agent did not follow the required policy steps. There is no clear authentication of the user beyond looking up emails, and no verification that the orders belonged to the user. The agent executed order-changing write actions (return_delivered_order_items and modify_pending_order_items) without first confirming with the user. The selection of the speaker to return did not demonstrate checking which item was “more expensive yet not water-resistant” (no product detail checks for water resistance or price comparison), and the laptop modification did not verify availability of the exact 13-inch version or present alternative 13-inch options with the stated i5 and color preferences before acting. Finally, the agent did not provide correct final information or confirmation of outcomes, closing with a generic message instead. These issues violate the policy and fail the pass bar.
